name: Lumonic
description: Lumonic connects Claude to permission-aware portfolio monitoring and reporting data. Use it to discover entities, fields, dimensions, and metrics; build portfolio tables; summarize reporting status; identify missing submissions; validate LX expressions; generate refreshable Excel formulas; and inspect source context or traceback links. Claude can only access the Lumonic workspaces and data available to the authenticated user.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lumonic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lumonic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lumonic.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lumonic MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lumonic lists 24 MCP tools, including namespaces_list, namespaces_list_relationships, entities_list, entities_list_related, dimensions_list, schema_groups_list, schema_list_properties, discovery_search_properties, resources_list, resources_read, lx_validate, and lx_resolve.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lumonic?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lumonic in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Lumonic requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lumonic is developed by Lumonic. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
